name: retrieval-context
description: Builds retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) context by chunking documents, scoring chunks against a query with TF-IDF cosine similarity, and injecting the top-K results into a prompt.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to implement RAG (retrieval-augmented generation): splitting large text corpora into overlapping chunks, ranking those chunks by relevance to a user query using TF-IDF cosine similarity, and assembling the most relevant chunks into a context string for an LLM prompt. Ideal for question-answering over documents, knowledge-base lookups, and any scenario where you need to ground an LLM response in retrieved text.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The source text to split into chunks (used by chunkText).

parameters.name: options.chunkSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of characters per chunk (default: 500).

parameters.name: options.overlap
parameters.description: Number of characters to overlap between consecutive chunks (default: 50).

parameters.name: topK
parameters.description: Number of top-scoring chunks to return from search (default: 3).

parameters.name: documents
parameters.description: Array of documents (strings or objects) to index in RetrievalContext.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The search query used to score and retrieve relevant chunks.

parameters.name: separator
parameters.description: String separator used to join chunks in buildContext (default: '\n---\n').
